corpus.title: Semaglutide gastrointestinal adverse events
corpus.text: Semaglutide treatment was associated with nausea, vomiting and diarrhea. Gastrointestinal adverse events were the most frequently reported category and were generally mild to moderate in severity.

corpus.title: Tirzepatide tolerability
corpus.text: Tirzepatide showed dose dependent gastrointestinal effects including nausea and diarrhea. Discontinuation due to gastrointestinal adverse events occurred in a minority of participants.

corpus.title: GLP-1 receptor agonist class effects
corpus.text: Glucagon like peptide 1 receptor agonists share a class effect profile dominated by gastrointestinal symptoms such as nausea, vomiting and constipation.

corpus.title: Nausea management strategies
corpus.text: Slow dose escalation and dietary modification reduce nausea during initiation of incretin based therapy.

corpus.title: Semaglutide cardiovascular outcomes
corpus.text: A cardiovascular outcomes trial evaluated major adverse cardiac events with semaglutide. Gastrointestinal symptoms were recorded as adverse events but were not the primary endpoint.

corpus.title: Metformin renal dosing
corpus.text: Metformin dose adjustment is required in chronic kidney disease. Lactic acidosis risk increases with declining renal function.

corpus.title: Insulin glargine hypoglycemia
corpus.text: Nocturnal hypoglycemia rates were compared between basal insulin regimens. Gastrointestinal effects were not observed.

corpus.title: Statin myopathy surveillance
corpus.text: Muscle symptoms and creatine kinase elevation were monitored during statin therapy.

corpus.title: Warfarin bleeding risk
corpus.text: Anticoagulation with warfarin requires monitoring of the international normalized ratio to reduce major bleeding events.

corpus.title: Tirzepatide weight reduction
corpus.text: Body weight reduction was greater with tirzepatide than with placebo. The most common adverse events were gastrointestinal.

corpus.title: Vomiting definitions in trials
corpus.text: Standardized definitions of vomiting and emesis improve comparability of adverse event reporting across clinical trials.

corpus.title: Diarrhea grading scales
corpus.text: Common terminology criteria grade diarrhea by increase in stool frequency over baseline.

corpus.title: Proton pump inhibitor safety
corpus.text: Long term proton pump inhibitor use has been examined for fracture and infection risk.

corpus.title: Spontaneous reporting limitations
corpus.text: Spontaneous adverse event report counts cannot establish incidence because the exposed population denominator is unknown and reporting is voluntary.

corpus.title: Disproportionality analysis caution
corpus.text: Reporting odds ratios derived from spontaneous report databases are hypothesis generating and do not establish causality.

corpus.title: Label section structure
corpus.text: Structured product labeling organizes content into sections identified by codes, including adverse reactions and warnings.

corpus.title: Semaglutide label adverse reactions
corpus.text: The adverse reactions section of the semaglutide label lists nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain and constipation.

corpus.title: Tirzepatide label adverse reactions
corpus.text: The adverse reactions section of the tirzepatide label lists nausea, diarrhea, decreased appetite, vomiting and constipation.

corpus.title: Abdominal pain assessment
corpus.text: Abdominal pain reported during incretin therapy should be evaluated for pancreatitis when severe and persistent.

corpus.title: Constipation in incretin therapy
corpus.text: Constipation has been reported with glucagon like peptide 1 receptor agonists and may require dietary management.

corpus.title: Pancreatitis signal review
corpus.text: A review of pancreatitis reports in incretin based therapies concluded the evidence was inconclusive.

corpus.title: Gallbladder events
corpus.text: Cholelithiasis and cholecystitis have been reported with rapid weight reduction.

corpus.title: Thyroid C-cell tumors rodent
corpus.text: Rodent studies observed thyroid C cell tumors; human relevance is undetermined.

corpus.title: Injection site reactions
corpus.text: Local injection site reactions were mild and did not lead to discontinuation.

corpus.title: Retinopathy complications
corpus.text: Early worsening of diabetic retinopathy was observed with rapid glycemic improvement.

corpus.title: Hypoglycemia with sulfonylurea
corpus.text: Combination with sulfonylurea increased hypoglycemia frequency.

corpus.title: Renal impairment pharmacokinetics
corpus.text: No dose adjustment was required across renal impairment categories in pharmacokinetic studies.

corpus.title: Hepatic impairment exposure
corpus.text: Exposure was not meaningfully altered in participants with hepatic impairment.

corpus.title: Drug interaction gastric emptying
corpus.text: Delayed gastric emptying may affect the absorption rate of concomitant oral medications.

corpus.title: Adverse event coding dictionary
corpus.text: Preferred terms from a controlled medical dictionary are used to code reported adverse events consistently.
